findings.evidence: `Mathlib/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/Ideal/Lemmas.lean:203`: `Associates.mk I ^ n ≤ Associates.mk (Ideal.span {x}) ↔ x ∈ I ^ n`; `FactorSet.lean:460`: `p ^ k ≤ m ↔ k ≤ count p m.factors`. `AdicValuation.lean:151-155` uses precisely this pair.
findings.fix: Drop the "no lemma anywhere" clause and state only what is true — that Mathlib has no single named `le_count_iff` at this pin, so the two-lemma composition is packaged here.
findings.issue: The comment justifying `le_count_iff_mem_pow` claims "no lemma anywhere relating `Associates.count … factors` to membership of a height-one prime power". That is false: `Associates.le_singleton_iff` (`Mathlib/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/Ideal/Lemmas.lean:202`, already imported here via `TauCeti/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/Ideal.lean`) composed with `Associates.prime_pow_dvd_iff_le` (`Mathlib/RingTheory/UniqueFactorizationDomain/FactorSet.lean:459`) is exactly this statement.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn 'primeOfNotMem\|primeBelow\|integer_comap_map_asIdeal' TauCeti/` returns no hits for those names; `Spectrum.lean:178-179` is `rw [← w.intValuation_le_pow_iff_mem, w.intValuation_apply, w.intValuationDef_if_neg hb, WithZero.exp_le_exp, neg_le_neg_iff, Nat.cast_le]`; `ls TauCeti/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/SInteger/` shows `Basic.lean  Spectrum.lean`.
findings.fix: Rewrite the description against the head commit: current declaration names, the actual one-`rw` derivation of `le_count_iff_mem_pow`, and drop or invert the placement contest now that the move was made.
findings.issue: The PR description is stale and contradicts its own diff in three places: (a) it names `primeOfNotMem`, `primeBelow`, `heightOneSpectrumEquiv`, `valuation_heightOneSpectrumEquiv`, `intValuationDef_primeOfNotMem` and `integer_comap_map_asIdeal`, none of which exist (the code has `integerPrimeOverOfNotMem`, `integerPrimeUnder`, `integerHeightOneSpectrumEquiv`, `valuation_integerHeightOneSpectrumEquiv`, `intValuationDef_integerPrimeOverOfNotMem`, and uses Mathlib's `Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_isMaximal`); (b) it says `le_count_iff_mem_pow` is derived from `Associates.prime_pow_dvd_iff_le` via `Associates.mk_le_mk_iff_dvd`, `Ideal.dvd_iff_le`, `Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem` — the actual proof uses none of these, only `intValuation_le_pow_iff_mem`/`intValuationDef_if_neg`; (c) its contested-position section argues at length that the flat `SInteger.lean` layout is kept, while the diff renames it to `SInteger/Basic.lean` and adds `SInteger/Spectrum.lean`.

summary: Docstrings on the new declarations are accurate and the provenance credit checks out against the roadmap, but the justification comment on `le_count_iff_mem_pow` misstates what Mathlib contains, and the PR description names declarations that do not exist and argues against a rename the diff performs.
